title: APMC Mandi Market Prices
summary_lines: 1. Modal price for Onion in primary APMC market is ₹1,850 per quintal.
2. Daily arrivals remain steady with moderate demand across regional trading yards.
3. High quality cured bulbs are fetching premium rates above ₹2,200 per quintal.
steps: 1. Grade produce into uniform sizes and discard damaged stock before dispatch.
2. Cure and dry bulbs thoroughly to prevent weight loss during transit.
3. Track daily APMC modal rates before loading vehicles.
speak_text: Today the modal price in the APMC market is 1,850 rupees per quintal. Market demand is stable with premium prices for graded produce.
